correctness.rationale: Direct Gram calculation gives a permutation block diagonal form with blocks H_j=(a_{i\ell})_{i<=j<=ell}; hence rank sum and universal upper bound floor((n+1)^2/4). Odd optimality is equivalent to an invertible central m-square block. Even optimality is equivalent to two overlapping full-rank rectangular blocks and is counted by splitting their common square at ranks m and m-1, including the necessary exclusion of the column/row spaces. Codimension one/two follows from standard determinant and maximal-minor determinantal codimensions. The q-integer formulas are consistent with exhaustive prime-field and GF4 computations. No finite search is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The known Frobenius classification makes all T_n, n>=3, non-Frobenius but gives no quantitative measure of how far their associative pairings can approach nondegeneracy. The exact sharp rank, count of optimal functionals and even/odd codimension transition resolve the natural optimal-degeneracy question for an infinite classical algebra family, with a persistent parity difference at fixed q. This is not a relabeling of the existence theorem, a single arbitrary slice, or a numerical small gain. Broader structural matrix algebras and all lower ranks are not claimed.
